transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... student health told me I had to come. They wouldn't clear me for these youth workshops I'm supposed to do. They said my weight is too low, and that the number keeps dropping, but... I don't really see the issue. It just feels like what happens when I'm really focused and busy.
Do you think your weight is normal?

Um... I don't know. I guess it's low, since they keep telling me it is. But... it doesn't feel like a big deal to me. I know people keep saying it’s dangerous, but... it feels exaggerated. Like they’re making my body the problem, when I’m just trying to stay sharp for school and the workshops.
Do you think you're eating enough?

I mean... I guess so. I just... I sort of plan things out so I don't really have to eat much. Like, I'll just have coffee before studio, and... maybe I'll eat a little bit of something from the café if people are around and watching me. But I stay away from stuff like bread or anything with oil in it. It just... it feels like it would ruin all the control I have right now.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean... just the thought of it makes me kind of... panic. Like, if I were to eat a normal dinner, or... I don't know, something cooked in butter... I just feel like everyone would immediately see it. Like they'd know I just gave up and lost all my discipline. So... yeah. I try not to let that happen.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?
No. I don't do that. I just... I stick to what I planned.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while eating?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I don't let that happen.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No. Um... I don't throw up. I just... no.
Do you ever feel like you're eating much more quickly than usual?
No... I don't really eat fast. I take my time.
Is your decision to limit what you eat mostly because you're trying to avoid gaining weight?

Yeah... I mean, I guess. It's just... the thought of gaining even a single pound kind of... makes me panic. Like if I were to eat a normal dinner, or... something with butter in it... I just feel like everyone would be able to see that I lost my discipline. So... yeah. I just try to avoid that.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food that's much larger than what most people would eat in a similar time period?
No. Um... definitely not. I don't... I don't eat large amounts of anything.
Have you ever eaten a normal amount of food and then felt extremely guilty about it?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't... I try not to eat a normal amount in the first place, so... I guess I haven't really had that happen.
Do you think your body is the right shape?

Um... I don't know. Not really. 

I guess... like, when I look at photos from this showcase recently... I don't really see the artwork first. I just... I zoom in on my arms, and my waist. And um... I don't know, if I look small enough, I just feel like I'm... serious, I guess. Like I'm put-together. But... yeah.
Have you ever eaten an amount of food that felt excessive to you, even if it wasn't more than what most people would eat?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I just don't eat that much, so it doesn't really happen.
Have you had your period in the past few months?
Um... no. Not for a while. I don't really keep track of it, but... yeah, it's been a few months, I think.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food that you couldn't stop or control?
No. I... I don't really lose control like that. Like I said, I just... I'm pretty careful about it, so... no.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food in a short time that was more than you planned to eat?
No. I... I usually just stick to whatever I planned out. So... no, not really.
Is your main reason for limiting your food intake to avoid gaining weight?

Um... yeah. I guess. It's just... even the idea of gaining a pound makes me kind of... panic. Like, if I were to just eat a normal dinner, or... eat something with butter in it... I feel like everyone would immediately be able to see that I lost my discipline. So... yeah. I just don't.
Do you think you would be fat even if other people thought you were underweight?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't... I don't really pay attention to what other people think about my weight. So... I'm not sure.
Do you think you are underweight?

Um... not really. I mean... I know people keep saying it’s dangerous, but... it just feels exaggerated to me. Like they’re... making my body into this big problem, and I’m just trying to stay sharp for school. So... yeah. I don't really see it.
